ANTI_DELETE.description: Set to 'true' to show deleted messages by default.

ALWAYS_ONLINE.description: Set to 'true' to stay online 24/7 by default.

AUTO_STATUS_SEEN.description: Set to 'true' for automatic status viewing.

AUTO_STATUS_REACT.description: Set to 'true' for automatic reaction on status.

AUTO_STATUS_REPLY.description: Set to 'true' for auto reply on status seen.

ANTI_LINK.description: Set to 'true' to automatically remove group links by default.

AUTO_TYPING.description: Set to 'true' for automatic typing simulation by default.

AUTO_RECORDING.description: Set to 'true' for automatic recording simulation by default.

ANTI_CALL.description: Set to 'true' to automatically reject WhatsApp calls by default.

AUTO_REACT.description: Set to 'true' to automatically react to every message by default.

READ_MESSAGE.description: Set to 'true' to automatically mark all messages as read by default.

ANTI_BAD.description: Set to 'true' to automatically delete messages with bad words by default.
